content: Oncomelania is a genus of very small tropical freshwater snails, which are aquatic gastropod mollusks belonging to the family Pomatiopsidae. Certain species within the Oncomelania genus hold significant medical importance because they act as vectors for two serious human parasitic diseases. These snails can carry the blood fluke parasite responsible for schistosomiasis, as well as lung fluke parasites from the genus Paragonimus, which cause paragonimiasis. Oncomelania snails are distantly related to marine periwinkles but are more closely related to small marine snails within the family Rissoidae.
